title: The Lady of the Lake
notes: Meeting the Lady at the enchanted lake starts the Sword in the Stone quest (moved from World & story, Nov 21, 2026). The story around it: story → Legendary quests → Sword in the Stone. Open: whether a failed check can be tried again here (Classes & combat → Open questions); the links back to the choice after a reply are a first layout, not a decision.

n1.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n1.text: Long have these waters waited, traveller. Few come seeking me, and fewer still come worthy. Speak, and let the lake hear what manner of soul you are.

check.failCost: A light cost: she refuses her blessing.

chimeIns.text: I am King Alexander the All Conquering Legend and He Who Rules, and I vouch for them.

check.failCost: A heavy cost: she fights back, which starts a fight, with water spirits (fey) rising from the lake beside her.

n3.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n3.text: It lies far from here, bound in stone beneath an open sky. I will show you the way. But mark me: the stone yields only once. Fail it, and the blade is lost to you forever.

n4.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n4.text: There is truth in you. I feel it as I feel the rain. Take my blessing, and let the stone know you come in my name.

n5.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n5.text: Not today. Prove yourself in deed, not word, and perhaps the lake will think again.

n6.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n6.text: Boldly spoken. The old kings were bold too, and the stone answered them. Go, with what blessing a threat can buy.

n7.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n7.text: You dare threaten me at my own waters? Then let the lake answer you.

n8.speaker: Lady of the Lake
n8.text: A knight once knelt where you stand. He fell far from these waters, and his blade lies where he died. Bring it home to me, and I will know your worth.

n11.notes: Water spirits (fey) rise from the lake beside her. If the party wins: the scene The Lady of the Lake: beaten.

n12.notes: The deed: bring Sir Bedivere's Blade back from the chimera's lair (story → Legendary quests → Sword in the Stone). Then: the scene The Lady of the Lake: the blade returns.
